faqEntries.heading: How do I automatically move items?
faqEntries.content: Use Item Pipes with Fillers and Emptiers to automatically move items between storage and machines.

faqEntries.heading: How do I find Oil?
faqEntries.content: Look for Spilllilies on the surface. Dig underneath them to find Oily Stone, which can be extracted using an Oil Pump.

faqEntries.heading: Can I make renewable Oil?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Spilllilies can be used to create more Oily Stone, allowing you to build a renewable Oil setup. Place the Spilllilies above stone and they will slowly turn nearby blocks into Oily Stone.

faqEntries.heading: Why isn't my machine working?
faqEntries.content: Check that the machine has enough power and that any required items or fluids are being supplied correctly.

faqEntries.heading: How do I move and store fluids?
faqEntries.content: Fluid Pipes transport liquids between machines. Fluid Tanks can be used to store them for later use.

faqEntries.heading: How do I make Fuel?
faqEntries.content: Extract Oil using an Oil Pump and send it through Fluid Pipes into an Oil Refinery to turn it into Fuel.

item.howToTitle: How to use Advanced Machines Add-On

howToEntries.heading: Step 1: Enable Advanced Machines Add-On
howToEntries.content: Open your world settings and activate Advanced Machines under both Resource Packs and Behavior Packs. Make sure it appears in the Active list.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2: Open the Guide Book
howToEntries.content: When you enter your world, you'll receive the Advanced Machines Guide Book. Place it on the ground and interact with it to open the guide.

howToEntries.heading: Step 3: Craft your first power source
howToEntries.content: Start by crafting a power source such as a Solar Panel. This will generate WonderWatts (WW), which are used to power your machines.

howToEntries.heading: Step 4: Craft your first machine
howToEntries.content: Craft a Steel Foundry and connect it to your power source using Cables. Interact with the Steel Foundry to begin processing resources.

howToEntries.heading: Step 5: Start automating
howToEntries.content: Use Item Pipes, Fillers and Emptiers to automatically move items between chests and machines. You can continue expanding this into larger automated factories.

howToEntries.heading: Step 6: Need more help?
howToEntries.content: Craft the Advanced Machines Beginner's Book. This book will give you step-by-step instructions of how to get started with Advanced Machines. What to build first, how to connect machines, and how to go further!
